content: {"praised":["Acting and cast brought realism to the film.","High fantasy elements like wizards, witches, dragons were captivating.","Story was a wonderful retelling of a famous fairy tale.","Performances were praised as some of the best seen.","Visuals and music enhanced the fantasy atmosphere."],"criticized":["Film was overly violent and unsuitable for children.","Gender discrimination portrayed through male-dominated violence.","Plot was predictable, turning antagonist into protagonist.","Story lacked depth, focusing on revenge rather than character growth.","Themes reinforced negative stereotypes about fathers and women."]}
